basic_info.description: Calling all who dream of creating their idyllic home in Noe Valley!  This charming Edwardian fixer sits proudly on the corner of slow Sanchez just waiting for vision and design to bring it back to it's former glory or reinvent it into something new!  The 3 bed, 2 bathroom home has soaring ceiling heights in the original rooms, delightful period details with large windows flooding natural light throughout the living and dining rooms, a large central kitchen and bedrooms on 2 levels.  Heading downstairs the garage sprawls the entire footprint of the home with high ceilings providing opportunities for easy expansion or storage galore!  Space for 1 car parking and access to a simple inner lightwell round out the ground floor. The added perk of solar panels on the roof is the cherry on top!  Just a few blocks away from neighborhood cafes, shops, the J Church line, and a 5 minute drive to hop on the 280 freeway it's truly the perfect combination of convenience and community!
